info.title: AI Invoice Assistant
info.description:
Manage customers, products and invoices and calculate the turnover - through plain CRUD endpoints
(no AI) or through a chat with a local language model.

**Local access:** the service runs on this computer only, at `http://127.0.0.1:8000` (no login, one local user).
Start it with `python -m uvicorn api:app --app-dir app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000` or with Docker
(`docker run -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 -v invoice-data:/service/data invoice-assistant`).
Interactive documentation: `/docs`. Example: `curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/customers`

**Formats:** dates are DD/MM/YYYY, amounts in EUR, numbers like CUS-001, PRD-001, INV-001 are given by the service.

**The chat never saves.** It returns a reply or a checked proposal; the client saves a proposal with the matching
CRUD call only after the user's "Yes". Without the model server the chat answers 503, everything else keeps working.

**Errors:** every error answer is `{"detail": "..."}` - 400 data not valid, 404 number not found, 422 request body or
parameter missing / wrong type, 503 model server or database not available.

get.description: Is the service OK? The database must work (else 503); without the model server only the chat is down (degraded).

get.description: Return one customer, or 404 if the number doesn't exist.

put.description: Change name and address of a customer: 404 if the number doesn't exist, 400 if the data is not valid.

delete.description: Delete a customer: 404 if the number doesn't exist, 400 if it still has invoices.

400.description: The customer is used in invoices

delete.description: Delete a product: 404 if the code doesn't exist, 400 if an invoice line uses it.

get.description: Return all invoices, each with its total.

delete.description: Delete an invoice: 404 if the number doesn't exist, 400 if it is paid.

ChatIn.title: ChatIn
ChatIn.description: One chat message from the frontend. conversation_id is empty on the first message.

ui.title: Ui
ui.description: Forms the website opens, e.g. ["dates"] or ["customer"]

open.title: Open
open.description: True: the bot waits for an answer; the next message goes to it

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: Which bot answered: customer, product, invoice or question

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: The router bot's reasoning, shown to the user

ChatOut.title: ChatOut
ChatOut.description: The answer to one chat message: a reply (question, error or answer) or a proposal. Empty fields are left out.

CustomerIn.title: CustomerIn
CustomerIn.description: The data a client sends to create or change a customer.

CustomerOut.title: CustomerOut
CustomerOut.description: A customer as the API returns it.

CustomerTurnover.title: CustomerTurnover
CustomerTurnover.description: One row of R1: turnover per customer.

ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut
ErrorOut.description: The body of every error answer (400, 404, 503), e.g. {"detail": "Customer CUS-999 not found"}.

HealthOut.title: HealthOut
HealthOut.description: The state of the service: "degraded" = the model server is unreachable, only the chat is down.

HelpOut.title: HelpOut
HelpOut.description: The answer of the Help bot, with the sections of the user guide it used.

InvoiceIn.title: InvoiceIn
InvoiceIn.description: The data a client sends to create or change an invoice. Dates are DD/MM/YYYY, status paid or unpaid.

InvoiceOut.title: InvoiceOut
InvoiceOut.description: An invoice as the API returns it, with its lines and its total (calculated by Python).

LineIn.title: LineIn
LineIn.description: One invoice line. Without unit_price the product's sell_price is used.

LineOut.title: LineOut
LineOut.description: One saved invoice line: numbered, with the price of the day.

MonthTurnover.title: MonthTurnover
MonthTurnover.description: One row of R3: the turnover of one month (1 = January ... 12 = December).

ProductIn.title: ProductIn
ProductIn.description: The data a client sends to create or change a product. The price may be a number or text like "12,5".

ProductOut.title: ProductOut
ProductOut.description: A product as the API returns it.

ProductTurnover.title: ProductTurnover
ProductTurnover.description: One row of R2: quantity sold and turnover per product.

body.title: Body
body.description: The body for the CRUD call: like CustomerIn, ProductIn or InvoiceIn; empty for DELETE
